frames.title: Lesson 46 · Cleft sentences — practice and contrast

body: **Foco:** Cleft sentences — prática e contraste.
**Expressões:** In light of….
**Pronúncia:** Pausas e ritmo.
**22 palavras novas** (pesquisa).
**Texto do dia:** editorial / opinião.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo contrastar frases clivadas com frases simples e usar In light of… num editorial científico.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Editorial: What Peer Review Gets Wrong
paras: **In light of** recent retractions, it is time to ask what peer review is for. **It is not** fraud **that** most often escapes detection, **but** honest error. **What is needed is** transparency; **it is open data that** allows others to check.
**It was** an amateur analyst **who** found the mistake, **not** the journal. Reform, **it seems**, **must come** from the community.

items.q: Peer review most often misses fraud.
Open data lets others check results.

head: Frase simples
Clivada (ênfase)
rows: An amateur analyst found the mistake.
**It was an amateur analyst who found the mistake.**
Honest error most often escapes detection.
**It is honest error that most often escapes detection.**
Open data allows others to check.
**It is open data that allows others to check.**

blocks.body: **In light of** = *à luz de* (mais formal que *because of*): *In light of recent retractions, …* Cuidado: não use *in light of* + oração, e sim + substantivo.

items.s: ___ light of recent retractions, we should reflect. (In)
It is honest error ___ most often escapes detection. (that)
It was an amateur analyst ___ found the mistake. (who)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **In light of…** — À luz de…
**In view of…** — Em vista de…
**On balance,…** — No balanço,…
**As a result of…** — Como resultado de…
**Given the circumstances,…** — Dadas as circunstâncias,…
**It goes without saying that…** — Não precisa dizer que…
**Blow the whistle.** — Denunciar.
**Come clean.** — Confessar a verdade.
**Who found the mistake?** — Quem achou o erro?
**In light of recent retractions, what should we do?** — À luz das retratações recentes, o que devemos fazer?
**It is open data that allows others to check results.** — São os dados abertos que permitem aos outros checar resultados.

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido (thought groups) e mantenha o ritmo: sílabas fortes em intervalos regulares, fracas comprimidas.
words: In my view, | the plan | is sound.
Having reviewed the data, | we agreed.

prompts.model: In light of the data, we changed plans.
It was the weather that delayed us.
It is not luck but effort that counts.

blocks.task: Rewrite 4 simple sentences as cleft sentences and write 2 more of your own about science.
blocks.model: It is honest error that most often escapes detection. It is open data that allows others to check results. It was an amateur analyst who found the mistake. What we need is transparency. In light of recent retractions, reform is urgent. It is the community that must lead it.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
